statement: Oracle delivered over 300,000 GPUs to AI customers in the quarter, nearly triple Q4 FY2026 capacity, and states customer demand for AI training and inferencing continues exceeding available supply.
why: A named operator saying demand still exceeds supply after tripling GPU deliveries is a direct read on how tight merchant-GPU allocation remains.

impact.mechanism: Rapidly rising deliveries add supply, but stated excess demand means allocation and wait times stay tight.

evidence.excerpt: The company delivered over 300,000 GPUs to AI customers during the quarter -- nearly triple Q4 FY2026 capacity.
customer demand for AI training and inferencing services continues exceeding available supply

confidence.basis: Vendor's own characterisation of demand versus supply in a press release fetched at secondary tier.
